title: VPN timeout after login
description: Multiple users are reporting VPN timeout after login. Started around 10:20 AM. Authentication service looks healthy.

timeline.text: 10:00 AM identity provider configuration change deployed by the platform team.
10:25 AM token validation latency on the identity provider measured at 6 seconds.
PRIVATE: Customer Initech threatened to churn over this outage.

resolution: Root cause: the identity provider configuration change reduced the token validation timeout from 10 seconds to 2 seconds. Restored the timeout to 10 seconds and logins recovered within 5 minutes.

title: VPN login failures during authentication provider latency
description: VPN logins failing intermittently for the Chennai office. The authentication provider is responding slowly.

timeline.text: Authentication provider latency p95 rose above 3 seconds after a traffic spike.

resolution: Scaled out the authentication provider from 3 to 6 nodes. Latency returned to normal.

title: VPN client 7.2 login timeout
description: US users on VPN client version 7.2 time out at login. Users on 7.3 are unaffected.

timeline.text: Reproduced on client 7.2 only; the gateway logs show no errors.

resolution: Pushed VPN client 7.3 to all US users. Version 7.2 is blocked at the gateway.

title: Database Connection Failure
description: Payments API cannot connect to PostgreSQL. Checkout requests are failing with 500 errors.

timeline.text: Connection count on the primary reached 100 of 100 allowed connections.
A recent deploy was found leaking connections in the refund handler.

logs: payments-api FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
resolution: Rolled back the deploy that leaked connections, terminated idle sessions, and raised the pool limit for payments-api from 20 to 40.

title: VPN errors increasing after configuration change
description: VPN connection errors are increasing. Investigation is ongoing and no root cause has been identified.

timeline.text: A VPN configuration change occurred at 10:00 AM.

title: VPN timeout after login in staging
description: Staging VPN logins time out. Production is unaffected.

timeline.text: The staging identity provider certificate had expired.

resolution: Renewed the staging identity provider certificate.

title: Slack notifications delayed
description: Incident notifications to Slack arrive up to 10 minutes late for European teams.

timeline.text: The Slack API returned 429 Too Many Requests during the alert storm.

resolution: Added exponential backoff with jitter to the notification worker and honoured the Retry-After header.

title: VPN timeout after login
description: Globex users report VPN timeout after login.

timeline.text: Globex firewall rule blocked the identity provider subnet.

resolution: Globex-only fix: removed the firewall rule that blocked the identity provider subnet.
